title: Neurotypical woman with a head injury reaches the space non-speakers touch

tellings.quote: 92 there's a a neurotypical woman who has a head injury that is able to touch the space that non-speakers can touch

plain: A woman without autism who suffered a head injury is said to be able to reach the same inner "space" that autistic people who cannot speak are able to touch. Ky Dickens, maker of the documentary series The Telepathy Tapes, relays this from that project. If true, it would suggest the telepathy she studies is not limited to autistic people.
